CompanionStore.reason: Reviewed concrete production owners: LiveService/PreviewService, LocalDrafts/LocalFinished, value state and Sendable task/clock handles. Those implementations are UI-free; new Store constructor sites require review. Helper receipt notice and consumed IDs add only String/Set values. Approval warning owns only String/Date value fields.

AnnexManualClock.reason: Lock-protected value state and Sendable task continuations; no UIKit ownership.

CompanionRuntime.reason: Owns feedback presenter with UIKit windows/controllers; retain main-actor field destruction.

CompanionMarkdown.Box.reason: Immutable markdown document value; NSObject cache wrapper has no UI fields.

CompanionLifecycle.reason: Owns injected main-actor transition closure; arbitrary captures not proved UI-free.

CompanionTelemetry.reason: Owns SDK/MetricKit/subscription objects; their destruction affinity is not proved here.

CompanionImageBytes.reason: Immutable Data bytes, Sendable; no decoded UIImage is stored.

ResourceBundleClass.reason: Xcode-generated bundle-accessor class; no source patch. Runtime path remains unprotected.

CompanionCodeScanner.Coordinator.reason: DataScanner delegate owns an injected callback; possible UI captures.

CompanionLiveService.reason: Transport/value/task state; all three production callbacks in AppRoot capture Runtime WEAKLY, not raw UI. New assignments require capture review. Helper label cache and consumed IDs add only String dictionaries/sets. Icon store is an actor with immutable CGImage wrappers; registered icon fetch closure captures only Sendable AnnexTransporting.

CompanionLocalDrafts.reason: UserDefaults (thread-safe Foundation) plus fixed String; deinit performs no write.

CompanionPreferences.reason: Stored choices are values and UserDefaults; UIDevice is read during init, not retained. Start screen is an enum; cached Dispatcher desktops own only String and CompanionTarget values, with no UI objects or callbacks.

CompanionArchiveReader.reason: Sendable transport reference and value target/session/event dictionary; no UI fields.

CompanionDecisionQueue.reason: Values/tasks plus commit closure. Reviewed production construction captures only CompanionStore, whose reviewed concrete service/persistence graph is UI-free; no raw UI capture permitted.

CompanionLocalFinished.reason: UserDefaults plus fixed String; no UI fields or deinit I/O.

CompanionMessageSlices.Box.reason: Immutable array of message-slice values; NSObject cache wrapper has no UI fields.

CompanionPartExpansion.reason: Optional Bool and Observation registrar only.

CompanionStateLifetime.reason: Reviewed constructors produce Queue or actor-isolated Runtime. Factories capture Store or a Bool; Runtime retains isolated teardown for its UIKit fields. New constructor/capture sites require review.

CompanionTerminalFocus.reason: Only a WEAK UIKit reference and Bool/Observation registrar. Weak-slot destruction does not release the view.

CompanionPreviewService.reason: Boolean preview flags, including empty/keyboard-interaction fixtures and multiple Dispatchers, and Sendable AsyncStream continuation; no UI object/callback fields.

CompanionTerminalUIView.reason: UIView subclass strongly owns key-input view, layers and UI state; preserve isolation.

CompanionTerminalSession.reason: Injected terminal-channel protocol can own main-only objects; preserve isolation.

CompanionTerminalKeyInput.reason: UIView/UIKeyInput subclass, session and UIKit superclass state; preserve isolation.

CompanionArchiveTranscript.reason: Injected reader protocol is not constrained to UI-free implementations.

CompanionComposerPasteHook.HookView.reason: UIView superclass owns main-only UIKit state, even though explicit references are weak.

CompanionComposerPasteHook.Coordinator.reason: Owns UITextPasteItem array and injected main-actor callback; preserve isolation.

CompanionStreamDiagnostics.reason: Value cursor map, lock-protected Sendable transport diagnostic scopes and telemetry; no UI fields.

CompanionLiveTerminalChannel.reason: Sendable transport/tasks/continuation and text/number state; no UIView, layer or delegate owned.

CompanionTranscriptExpansion.reason: Dictionary owns only ARC-safe CompanionPartExpansion values.

CompanionPreviewTerminalChannel.reason: Value scope/text/size and Sendable stream continuation; no UI fields.

CompanionReadingBookmark.reason: Reading-position values and Bool plus the reviewed ARC-only ReadingViewport; no UIKit, SwiftUI handles or callbacks.

CompanionReadingViewport.reason: Gesture/scroll metrics and frame ranges plus a bounded restoration value (UUIDs, Doubles, Int, closed outcome); no task, UI object or callback ownership.

CompanionTimelineProjection.reason: UUID, Int counters/index dictionaries and Sendable timeline-row values; reachable image-byte wrappers are immutable Data with reviewed ARC-only teardown. No UI or callback ownership.

properties.toolIndices: [ String : ( row : Int , item : Int , part : Int ) ]

CompanionHelperPresetsScreen.reason: Optional routing snapshot contains only Sendable structs, arrays and String dictionaries; String/Bool/Observation state owns no UI, retained callback or cleanup resource. Read/write closures are used during calls and are not stored. Auto/quota policy and window values add only Sendable structs, Date and collections; freshness state is ContinuousClock.Instant and UUID values, with no retained task or timer.

CompanionIconStore.ImageBox.reason: Private immutable CompanionIconImage owns a Sendable CGImage only. Construction is confined to validated/downsampled ImageIO output in the store actor; no UIKit objects, closures, delegates or main-only teardown. Empty nonisolated deinit preserves ARC-only release.

CompanionFeedbackOpeningPress.reason: UIGestureRecognizer superclass owns UIKit tracking state; weak controller does not waive UIKit teardown affinity.

CompanionFeedbackMenuCapture.Anchor.reason: UIView superclass owns UIKit state, a gesture recognizer, weak UIControl collection and KVO observations of those controls. Observation callbacks capture the anchor weakly; keep UIKit and observation teardown on MainActor.

CompanionChatPerformance.DisplayTarget.reason: NSObject callback target has no stored fields, callbacks or UI ownership. The process-lifetime enum owns and invalidates the display link on MainActor; target deinit performs no cleanup.

CompanionFeedbackSettingsCapture.reason: Owns a UUID, immutable CoreGraphics bitmap pixels and a Sendable screenshot-unavailable enum. No UIKit views, callbacks or teardown work; fields can be ARC-released on any thread. Shared holder lets sheet dismissal clear pixels even if SwiftUI retains destination values.

CompanionComposerMemory.reason: Only an optional UTF-16 offset value, a COW String draft snapshot for exact remount validation, and numeric slash bookmarks; no String indices, TextSelection, UI objects, callbacks or teardown work. Snapshot is released at remount.

CompanionReadingTouchObserver.Anchor.reason: UIKit view/recognizer attachment and the view callback require MainActor teardown; retain synthesized isolated deinit. The recognizer weakly references the anchor and immediately fails without claiming touches.

ReadingOpeningTouch.reason: UIKit view/recognizer attachment and the view callback require MainActor teardown; retain synthesized isolated deinit. The recognizer weakly references the anchor and immediately fails without claiming touches.
